sampling_method.goal: 20 parks, sports centres, playground destinations, culture destinations and cafes; prefer 10 Innenstadt and 10 outer-city records where the catalogue permits it
sampling_method.selection: stable API response order with deliberate descriptive-name challenge rows; all IDs and coordinates frozen below
sampling_method.deep_review: four Innenstadt and four outer-city frozen rows per cohort where available; shortages are filled from the available stratum; every selected row is evaluated against the same five provider tracks
sampling_method.request_cap: maximum 50 successful provider-page or provider-API requests per source during this audit

sampling_notes: Sports-centre availability produced 2 Innenstadt and 18 outer-city records in the first complete 20-record sample; this shortfall is preserved.
The outer-city cafe query returned zero records because the current OSM cafe importer is bounded to an inner-city box; all 20 cafe rows are central and this shortfall is preserved.
Empty activities arrays mean there are no reviewed destination memberships yet. EXP-72 owns the first reviewed pilot, so parent-place evidence is only a multi-activity candidate signal.
Cafe quality fields are marked not_exposed_by_spots_endpoint rather than inferred from the richer Places endpoint.
